english.title: Large brand owner, online marketplace operator fail to comply with packaging waste data reporting obligation - England
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a large producer subject to obligations as an online marketplace operator in regulation 17 of the Packaging Waste (Data Reporting) (England) Regulations 2023, failed to report the information in Parts 2 and 4 of, and paragraph 23 of Schedule 1 to, those regulations to the Environment Agency every 6 months in accordance with that regulation and in such form and manner as the Environment Agency directed in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 17(1)(a) and (d) and 28(2)(b) and (7) of the Packaging Waste (Data Reporting) (England) Regulations 2023.
